title: Community
body: Polls support manual or timed closure, hidden/live totals, anonymous/named ballots and ranked preferences. One saved ballot per member may be revised before close. Ranked ballots list choice numbers best first; omitted choices can exhaust. Superlatives are admin-started numbered seasons: anonymous nominations for 48 hours, top five finalists per category, then anonymous voting for 48 hours. One nomination per member/category, no self-nomination, and deterministic tie resolution. Winners earn permanent season badges without Ottomans. Suggestions support anonymous submissions, Support/Oppose voting, audited staff statuses and searchable archives. AMA has upvotes only; admins answer/decline, and the submitter can inspect a declined question’s private status. Admin-created giveaways run for one hour to seven days with one to five winners. Paid entries require exact-fee confirmation, are charged once, and their fees leave circulation. Custom reward delivery remains visibly pending until staff acknowledges fulfillment. /steal privately copies one valid custom emoji into Chairs when Discord capacity and permissions allow it.

fields.question: Poll question or AMA question.
fields.choices: Pipe-separated choices within the configured maximum; default 20, up to 25.
fields.minutes: Poll deadline in minutes; omit for creator/admin manual close.
fields.results: Hidden until close or live results.
fields.anonymous: Keep ballot identities or submission author private as indicated by the feature.
fields.ranked: Rank distinct choice numbers, best first.
fields.categories: Only category names separated by |; community admins start the next season.
fields.sort: AMA newest, or admin upvote sorting.
fields.page: Archive page, twenty entries per page.
fields.prize: ottomans:amount, item:id, collectible:id, tool:id, recipe:id or custom:description; prize is per winner.
fields.winners: One to five distinct giveaway winners.
fields.hours: One to 168 hours, within configured giveaway limits.
fields.fee: Ottomans per entry, bounded by the configured maximum; omit for free entry.
fields.emoji: A custom Discord emoji written exactly as <:name:id> or <a:name:id>.
fields.name: Optional 2–32 character emoji name; omit to reuse the source name.

steps: Review poll privacy, visibility and closing mode before creating it.
Use one ballot and rank preferences in the requested order when enabled.
Nominate another member once per Superlative category, then return for the separate voting phase.
Search suggestion history and check your AMA status privately.
Review the exact paid giveaway entry fee before confirming.
Read the final draw and distinguish delivered rewards from pending custom fulfillment.
